target.title: fix(google): handle prefixed Gemini 2 image fallback
target.body:
Closes #102320

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Gemini 2.x models addressed as `google/gemini-*` or `models/gemini-*` were treated as supporting multimodal `functionResponse.parts`, so image tool results were embedded in the function response instead of being delivered through the existing separate image-turn fallback.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Google request builders now parse Gemini major versions with a prefix-tolerant pattern in both the bundled Google transport and the shared `packages/ai` Google converter. This keeps provider-prefixed Gemini 2.x ids aligned with bare Gemini 2.x ids while preserving Gemini 3 behavior.

## User Impact

Users running Gemini 2.x through Google provider-prefixed model ids no longer get the Gemini 2.x request shape that embeds image data inside `functionResponse`. Image tool results use the same separate image turn fallback that already worked for bare Gemini 2.x ids.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/transport-stream.test.ts packages/ai/src/providers/google-shared.parallel-image-repro.test.ts packages/ai/src/providers/google-shared.convert.test.ts` passed.
- `pnpm check:test-types` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** Provider-prefixed Gemini 2.x ids now use the Gemini 2.x image tool-result fallback instead of embedding image data in `functionResponse.parts`.
**Environment tested:** Local Linux workspace, Node 22.22.0, branch `fix/102320-google-prefixed-gemini2-image-fallback`.
**Steps run after the patch:** Called the real `buildGoogleGenerativeAiParams` extension request builder and the real shared `convertMessages` converter from source with an image-returning tool result, comparing `google/gemini-2.5-pro` against bare `gemini-2.5-pro`.
**Evidence after fix:**

```text
{
  "extensionPrefixed": {
    "roles": [
      "user",
      "model",
      "user",
      "user"
    ],
    "imageEmbeddedInFunctionResponse": false,
    "separateImageTurn": true
  },
  "extensionBare": {
    "roles": [
      "user",
      "model",
      "user",
      "user"
    ],
    "imageEmbeddedInFunctionResponse": false,
    "separateImageTurn": true
  },
  "sharedPrefixed": {
    "roles": [
      "user",
      "model",
      "user",
      "user"
    ],
    "imageEmbeddedInFunctionResponse": false,
    "separateImageTurn": true
  },
  "sharedBare": {
    "roles": [
      "user",
      "model",
      "user",
      "user"
    ],
    "imageEmbeddedInFunctionResponse": false,
    "separateImageTurn": true
  }
}
```

**Observed result after the fix:** The prefixed and bare Gemini 2.x ids now produce the same request shape in both Google converters: no inline image data inside `functionResponse`, and a separate `Tool result image:` turn is emitted.
**Not tested:** A live Google or Vertex HTTP request was not run; this proof verifies the local production request-shaping path that determines the 400-triggering payload shape.

## Root Cause

The Gemini major-version checks used `^gemini`, so ids that included a provider or model path prefix missed the Gemini 2.x match and fell through to the default `true` capability result.

## Regression Test Plan

- Added provider-prefixed and `models/`-prefixed Gemini 2.x cases to the existing Google transport image tool-result fallback test.
- Added matching prefixed cases to the shared `packages/ai` Google converter repro test.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Gemini 2.x image tool results for provider-prefixed model ids follow the existing separate image-turn fallback instead of producing the unsupported multimodal function-response shape.

## Security Impact

- New permissions? No.
- Secrets handling changed? No.
- New network calls? No.
